```{r setup}
#| include: false

library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(glue)
library(here)
library(knitr)
library(gt)
library(tidyr)

# Load all data from Excel
excel_file <- here("jpbsCVdata", "cv_data_with_education.xlsx")

# Read Administrative data
admin <- read_excel(excel_file, sheet = "Administrative") %>%
  filter(highlight == TRUE | is.na(highlight)) %>%
  arrange(display_order)

# Read Education data
edu <- read_excel(excel_file, sheet = "Education") %>%
  filter(highlight == TRUE | is.na(highlight)) %>%
  arrange(display_order) %>%
  mutate(
    where = paste(location_city, location_state, sep = ", "),
    institution = institution,
    degree = degree,
    startYear = as.character(start_year),
    endYear = as.character(end_year),
    # Combine detail columns
    details = list(na.omit(c(
      if(!is.na(detail_1)) detail_1 else NA,
      if(!is.na(detail_2)) detail_2 else NA,
      if(!is.na(detail_3)) detail_3 else NA
    )))
  )

# Read Certifications
certifications <- read_excel(excel_file, sheet = "Certifications") %>%
  filter(highlight == TRUE | is.na(highlight)) %>%
  arrange(display_order)

# Read Employment data - Handle Month-Year format
employment <- read_excel(excel_file, sheet = "Employment") %>%
  mutate(
    start_sort = paste0(
      sub(".*-", "", if_else(is.na(start_date), "2000", start_date)),
      "-",
      case_when(
        grepl("January", start_date) ~ "01",
        grepl("February", start_date) ~ "02",
        grepl("March", start_date) ~ "03",
        grepl("April", start_date) ~ "04",
        grepl("May", start_date) ~ "05",
        grepl("June", start_date) ~ "06",
        grepl("July", start_date) ~ "07",
        grepl("August", start_date) ~ "08",
        grepl("September", start_date) ~ "09",
        grepl("October", start_date) ~ "10",
        grepl("November", start_date) ~ "11",
        grepl("December", start_date) ~ "12",
        TRUE ~ "00"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(current), desc(start_sort))

# Process Long-term employment
ltWork <- employment %>%
  filter(current == TRUE | (!is.na(end_date) & as.numeric(sub(".*-", "", end_date)) >= 1997)) %>%
  mutate(
    startMonth = if_else(!is.na(start_date), sub("-.*", "", start_date), ""),
    startYear = if_else(!is.na(start_date), sub(".*-", "", start_date), ""),
    endMonth = case_when(
      is.na(end_date) | current == TRUE ~ "Present",
      TRUE ~ sub("-.*", "", end_date)
    ),
    endYear = case_when(
      is.na(end_date) | current == TRUE ~ "",
      TRUE ~ sub(".*-", "", end_date)
    )
  )

# Process Short-term employment
stWork <- employment %>%
  filter(current == FALSE & !is.na(end_date) & as.numeric(sub(".*-", "", end_date)) < 1997) %>%
  mutate(
    startMonth = if_else(!is.na(start_date), sub("-.*", "", start_date), ""),
    startYear = if_else(!is.na(start_date), sub(".*-", "", start_date), ""),
    endMonth = if_else(!is.na(end_date), sub("-.*", "", end_date), ""),
    endYear = if_else(!is.na(end_date), sub(".*-", "", end_date), "")
  )

# Read Publications
publications <- read_excel(excel_file, sheet = "Publications") %>%
  arrange(desc(year))

# Read Honors
honorsGrants <- read_excel(excel_file, sheet = "Honors") %>%
  arrange(desc(year))

# Read Working Papers
pip <- read_excel(excel_file, sheet = "WorkingPapers")

# Read Other Publications
otherPubsMonos <- read_excel(excel_file, sheet = "OtherPublications") %>%
  arrange(desc(year))
```
